metas.name: A Story of Derry
metas.description: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit. Available on HBO Max in 4K.

metas.name: Evil Dead Burn
metas.description: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death. Available on HBO Max in 1080p.

metas.name: Lee Cronin's the Mummy
metas.description: Eight years after her sudden disappearance in Egypt, a severely traumatized teenager is returned to her shattered family in New Mexico, triggering a visceral nightmare as they realize she is hosting an ancient, demonic parasite. Available on HBO Max in 4K.

metas.name: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
metas.description: Dr. Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship - with consequences that could change the world as they know it - and Spike's encounter with Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: He's Watching You
metas.description: A teenager investigating mysterious murders in his small town discovers a collection of VHS tapes that could reveal the identity of a notorious serial killer. Available on Prime Video in 1080p.
